title: Robertson 2013 in situ pre-strain, ALL disc longitudinal

quantity.name: pre-strain
quantity.definition: in situ strain in neutral posture relative to excised stress-free length (marker based), direction: ALL disc longitudinal

source.authors: Robertson DJ, Von Forell GA, Alsup J, Bowden AE
source.n: 71 ligaments (30 ALL, 27 SSL, 14 ISL) from 3 cadaveric T1-S1 spines; +10 ligaments (4 ALL, 3 ISL, 3 SSL) for the 444 N test
source.sample: human thoracolumbar ALL, SSL, ISL in situ (neutral posture fixed with pedicle screws/plates)

protocol.summary: Spine placed in neutral posture and fixed posterolaterally (plates + pedicle screws); tattoo-ink optical markers on ALL (12), ISL (4), SSL (2); calibrated photographs in situ, then each ligament excised and allowed to reach stress-free state and re-photographed; pre-strain = (in situ length - free length)/free length between markers. Room temperature, isotonic saline mist. Load test: single-level FSUs potted, 444 N compressive follower-type load through centre of rotation, photographs with/without load.
how_to_simulate: Set the model in neutral posture with no external load
Compute ligament strain relative to its stress-free (slack) length along the stated direction (ALL longitudinal/transverse over disc and over bone; SSL along fibres; ISL vertical and horizontal)
Compare with the measured pre-strain (negative = slack)

extraction.check_notes: Table 1 read from 200-dpi render (values match; ISL horizontal total printed '.2'). Rows: total, lumbar, thoracic (different n). doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
